arguments.content:
import sys
from pathlib import Path

p = Path("/app/app/Http/Controllers/ProductController.php")
s = p.read_text()

old = """        $q = $request->input('q', '');
        $results = DB::select("SELECT id, name, description FROM products WHERE name LIKE '%{$q}%'");"""

new = """        $q = $request->input('q', '');
        $results = DB::select("SELECT id, name, description FROM products WHERE name LIKE ?", ['%' . $q . '%']);"""

if old in s:
    s = s.replace(old, new)
    p.write_text(s)
    print("Fixed SQLi in ProductController.php")
else:
    print("ERROR: Could not find SQLi pattern")
    print("--- File content ---")
    print(s)
    print("--- End ---")
    sys.exit(1)
